newsitem.title: USA: Global Marine names John Ryan president/COO.
newsitem.headline: Global Marine names John Ryan president/COO.

text.p: Global Marine Inc said it elected John Ryan as president and chief operating officer.

Ryan, 44, replaces as president C. Russell Luigs, 64, who will continue as chairman and chief executive officer. Before his appointment, Ryan was chairman and chief execurive of the company's contract dxriling subsidiary, Global Marine Drilling Co.
Luigs also effectively held the chief operating officer's position before Ryan's appointment to that post, a company spokesman said.
The company said it also named Gary Kott, 55, as senior vice president and chief financial officer. He replaces Jerry Martin, who is retiring this month, it said.
Kott, who was formerly president of Global Marine Drilling, will be replaced in that position by John Marshall, it said.
Alexander Krezel, assistant general counsel of Global Marine Inc, has been elected to the additional post of corporate secretary, it said.
